priority_items.title: Anwar will invite Min Aung Hlaing for official visit tied to Rohingya repatriation
priority_items.summary: Anwar (16 Sep podcast, Reuters original): will invite MAH; Malaysia like ASEAN is not ready to recognise Myanmar's new government but needs an authority to negotiate returns. CLAIM fifth AMS host after LAO/THA/KHM/VNM; Myanmar agreed 5,000 with ~1,500 in 1–2 weeks. Invitation ≠ visit. No Home Ministry/MFA invitation text. 5PC political-representation stress test.
